privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.p1: Personal data is information that directly or indirectly relates to or can relate to your person. As a legal basis regulating data protection and conditions for the processing of your data, we apply the Personal Data Protection Law.
privacy-policy.p5: hereinafter referred to as the Pharmaceutical Institution
privacy-policy.p6: as the data controller, before collecting and processing personal data in accordance with Article 23 of the Personal Data Protection Law, hereby
privacy-policy.p7: informs about the conditions for collecting and processing personal data
privacy-policy.p8: It is possible to visit and use our website without disclosing your identity or any other data related to it. When visiting our website, taking into account the nature of the Internet, data that record users are collected, but are not sufficient for the identification of a specific person and represent statistical indicators used to improve the quality of the website. Such information may include the name of the Internet browser, number of visits, average time spent on the page, type of computer and technical information about the connection that the user uses when visiting the website, such as the operating system and Internet service provider, IP (Internet Protocol) address assigned by providers that are different for each Internet user, as well as similar information.
privacy-policy.p9: Types of personal data we use:
privacy-policy.p10: PERSONAL DATA: for contact such as name, surname, address, e-mail, phone number
privacy-policy.p11: DATA ON BUSINESS CONTACTS: such as the address of the business entity, business e-mail
privacy-policy.p12: SENSITIVE PERSONAL DATA: gender, date of birth
privacy-policy.p13: DATA ON THE CONTRACT: such as the content of the business cooperation agreement
privacy-policy.p14: PAYMENT INFORMATION: such as bank account number, claims for compensation, payment of obligations from contracts
privacy-policy.p16: For providing services: to deliver the goods you purchased from us through the www.apoteka-dar.rs online store, we need your contact information to deliver the goods to the desired address;
privacy-policy.p17: Fulfillment of requests - resolving complaints, objections: we strive to resolve them in an appropriate manner in accordance with the Law. In order to have sufficient information to carry out this procedure and make the correct decision, as well as to provide feedback regarding the complaint - it is necessary to collect certain information about you. Also, if you want a refund, it will be necessary to fill out the prescribed form - the so-called NI form, in which your ID number is entered, as required by applicable regulations.
privacy-policy.p18: Contracting - in order to conclude a contract, we need to verify that the person with whom we are entering into a contractual relationship is authorized to do so. The same applies to the execution of certain contractual provisions by persons designated for this purpose. Sometimes it is necessary to verify the identity of these individuals to ensure that we are acting correctly. We undertake these activities for the purpose of fulfilling the obligations arising from the contract we have entered into with you to comply with legal requirements.
privacy-policy.p19: Offer notifications - if you have signed up to receive occasional notifications about promotions and other benefits, you have shared with us some of your data that we can use to send these notifications to you as long as you want.
privacy-policy.p20: We take security measures - such as CCTV cameras - and have access to security data about our office spaces to ensure that our partners, customers, visitors, and property are protected.
privacy-policy.p21: Pharmacy 'DAR' processes certain sensitive personal data because of the obligations we have to fulfill to the extent and manner prescribed by law:
privacy-policy.p22: Data about your health status, including records of your absence from work due to health reasons; medical documentation, medical reports, and the like for the processing of any claims for damages that occurred in our retail facility or business premises. We will not record your data from your medical records, except when it is explicitly necessary. It is possible that this data will be forwarded to our insurance company to act upon your claim for damages. In the event that legal proceedings are initiated against us, this data may be made available to the competent court during the proceedings.
privacy-policy.p23: Who has access to your personal data?
privacy-policy.p24: We provide your personal data to the following individuals:
privacy-policy.p25: Third parties acting on our behalf (processors). In these cases, such third parties may use your personal data solely for the purposes listed above and only in accordance with our instructions.
privacy-policy.p26: Partners in sectors providing the services listed above may have access to your personal data, but only when strictly necessary to perform their duties and when the partner is obliged to maintain the confidentiality of the information;
privacy-policy.p27: Insurance companies that provide services to the company Pharmacy Institution 'DAR' and its partners
privacy-policy.p28: Third parties responsible for keeping your personal data, independent of Pharmacy Institution 'DAR' (these are externally engaged individuals, independent auditors, lawyers, tax advisors, etc.)
privacy-policy.p29: If required by law or court order, for example, law enforcement or other government agencies.
privacy-policy.p30: How long do we keep your personal data?
privacy-policy.p31: We keep your personal data for a certain period of time while they are necessary for the processing purpose, after which we delete them or prevent access, i.e., they become anonymous. The criteria based on which the data retention period is determined are:
privacy-policy.p32: The duration of your contractual relationship;
privacy-policy.p33: As long as we have established relations with you;
privacy-policy.p34: According to the legal conditions that apply to us.
privacy-policy.p36: When using certain functionalities (applications, requests) on our website in the contact form, request for an offer for the sale of goods, request for receiving news, information, and promotions...
privacy-policy.p37: we process your personal data (personal data on identity and contact information) only if you voluntarily provide them on our website for using our services and products. These personal data may include your name, surname, e-mail, telephone number, and/or other contact information and will be used in accordance with the privacy policy and purpose for which you left them.
privacy-policy.prc: Data retention period/criteria for determining the data retention period:
privacy-policy.p41: IP address of the device from which the query was sent and which has internet access
privacy-policy.p43: Name and URL of the downloaded file
privacy-policy.p44: Website/application from which access is made (referrer URL)
privacy-policy.p45: The browser you are using and, if necessary, the operating system of the computer that supports the Internet, as well as the name of your provider
privacy-policy.p46: The server temporarily stores these data in a so-called log file for the following purposes:
privacy-policy.p47: Ensuring the establishment of an uninterrupted connection
privacy-policy.p48: Ensuring comfortable use of our website/application
privacy-policy.p49: Assessment of system security and stability
privacy-policy.p50: The legal basis for processing the IP address is Article 12, paragraph 1, point 6) of the Law on Personal Data Protection (legitimate interest). Our legitimate interest arises from the above-mentioned purpose of data processing.
privacy-policy.p51: In general, we do not transfer this data to third parties.
privacy-policy.p52: The data is stored temporarily for the duration of the website visit and is then automatically deleted. After you leave our website, geolocation data is deleted.
privacy-policy.p53: We use so-called cookies on our website in accordance with Article 12, paragraph 1, point 6) of the Law on Personal Data Protection (legitimate interest). We believe that the interest in optimizing our website is justified within the meaning of the above provision. Cookies are small files that are stored on your device (laptop, tablet, smartphone, etc.) when you visit our website. Cookies do not harm your device, do not contain viruses, trojans or other malicious software. Information about the device you use is stored in cookies. However, this does not mean that we are familiar with your identity. On the one hand, the use of cookies serves to make your visit to the website more pleasant. For example, we use so-called session cookies to recognize that you have already visited certain parts of our site or that you are already logged in to your user account. They are automatically deleted after you leave our website. In addition, we also use temporary cookies that are stored on your device for a certain period of time. When you visit our website again, it is automatically recognized that you have already been to the site and what settings you have made, so you do not have to repeat these actions.
privacy-policy.p54: On the other hand, we use cookies to statistically record the use of our website, in order to optimize the offer and display information tailored to your interests. These cookies allow us to automatically recognize you when you visit our website again. These cookies are automatically deleted after a certain time. Most browsers automatically accept cookies. However, you can set your browser so that cookies are not stored on your computer or so that a message always appears before a new cookie is created. However, completely disabling cookies may mean that you cannot use all the features of our website.
privacy-policy.p55: DATA PROCESSING FOR SECURITY REASONS (VIDEO SURVEILLANCE)
privacy-policy.p56: We process your data also via video surveillance that we have implemented in our stores and business premises for your and our protection, based on a legally justified interest in protecting property, employees, customers, and visitors, especially to protect against the following identified risks:
privacy-policy.p57: Unauthorized access to premises and facilities;
privacy-policy.p58: Theft, loss, and unauthorized use of protected objects;
privacy-policy.p59: Introduction of weapons, explosives, radioactive, and other dangerous objects and materials;
privacy-policy.p60: Burglary, sabotage, and violent attack on the facility or confiscation of objects;
privacy-policy.p61: Unauthorized access to data and documentation;
privacy-policy.p62: Protection of vehicles for the transport of money and other means of transport.
privacy-policy.p63: The legal basis for processing data through video surveillance is Article 29 and 30 of the Law on Private Security.
privacy-policy.p64: Video recordings will not be publicly disclosed or provided to third parties, except in cases where it represents our legal obligation or authorization. Our partner who provides us with private security services and is responsible for the physical and technical security of our stores has access to video recordings. In addition, for the purpose of maintaining the video surveillance system, we have engaged a service technician who may have access to video recordings only to ensure its functioning.
privacy-policy.p65: Video recordings are kept for 30 days. Copies of video recordings are kept longer than 30 days in certain situations (legal proceedings). Video recordings that are no longer needed are deleted immediately (end of legal proceedings).
privacy-policy.p66: PROCESSING OF DATA THAT YOU PROVIDE TO US BY E-MAIL.
privacy-policy.p67: We treat your personal data that you provide to us via contact forms, phone or email, as confidential. We process your data only for the specified purpose, in order to respond to your inquiry. The legal basis for data processing is Article 12, paragraph 1, item 6) of the Law on Personal Data Protection (legitimate interest). Our and your (legitimate) interest in such data processing arises from the need to respond to your inquiries, to solve existing problems, and thereby ensure your satisfaction as our customer or user of our website.
privacy-policy.p68: If you participate in any of our surveys, your participation is voluntary. For anonymous surveys, we do not keep any data that would allow us to conclude who the participant is. We only store the date and time of your participation. Any personal data that you have provided us through the survey is considered voluntarily given and is stored in accordance with the provisions of the Law on Personal Data Protection. Please do not enter names or similar data in the free fields, which would allow us to conclude who it is, whether it is you or other persons. In case you have given consent to conduct the survey, the legal basis for data processing is based on your consent in accordance with Article 12, paragraph 1, item 1) of the Law on Personal Data Protection. In that case, you have the right to revoke your consent at any time. Revocation of consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing that was carried out based on consent prior to revocation. Details on data processing in relation to surveys are regulated by the data protection rules of each individual survey.
privacy-policy.p69: Generally, we do not transfer data to third parties. Exceptionally, our partners (processors) will process data on our behalf. All of our partners are chosen very carefully and are contractually obligated to keep personal data confidential, in accordance with Article 45 of the Law on Personal Data Protection. Additionally, in some cases there is a need to forward your inquiries to other contractual partners (e.g. suppliers for inquiries regarding specific products) for processing. In these cases, the inquiry is previously anonymized, so it cannot be determined who it is. If there is a need to transfer your personal data in a specific case, we will inform you in advance and request your consent. The results of our surveys are generally used only for our own purposes. We generally do not forward this data to third parties, unless you have given us explicit consent for that.
privacy-policy.p70: All personal data that you provide to us when asking a question (suggestions, praises or criticisms) through this website or via email, will be deleted or anonymized no later than 90 days after giving the final response. Our experience has shown that after 90 days, there are usually no further questions regarding our response.
privacy-policy.p72: With your consent, we record your behavior as a user of our website and newsletter. User behavior tracking primarily involves data on the sections where you have spent time and which links you have used. In this way, we create personalized user profiles with your personal data and/or with the data of your e-mail address in order to better adapt our communication in the form of newsletters, on-site advertising, and printed material to your personal interests, thus improving our offer.
privacy-policy.p73: The legal basis for the above-mentioned data processing is Article 12, paragraph 1, point 6), of the Personal Data Protection Law (legitimate interest) or Article 12, paragraph 1, point 1), of the Personal Data Protection Law (consent). The processing of customer data for our advertising purposes or for the advertising needs of third parties is considered a legitimate interest. Right to object: At any time and completely free of charge, you can object to the processing of data for the above-mentioned purposes through any communication channel. After you object, we will no longer process your data, with the objection not affecting the processing that was carried out based on consent before the objection. To this end, it is sufficient to send an e-mail or letter via post to our contact address.
privacy-policy.p74: In general, we do not forward this data to third parties.
privacy-policy.p75: If you revoke your consent for individual advertising or do not agree with certain promotional activities, we will delete your data from the corresponding mailing list. If you object, your contact address will be blocked for further data processing for advertising purposes. Please note that in exceptional cases, even after receiving your objection, there may be a few deliveries of advertising material. This is technically conditioned by the time required to prepare the advertising material and does not mean that we do not respect your objection. Thank you for your understanding.
privacy-policy.p76: DATA PROCESSING WHEN SIGNING UP FOR THE NEWSLETTER.
privacy-policy.p77: You have the option to subscribe to our newsletter on our website. If you agree to receive our newsletter, we will use your email address and possibly your name to send information about products, promotions, contests/sweepstakes, news, and store offers. We store and process this data for the purpose of sending the newsletter. The newsletter content includes promotions (offers, promotions, sweepstakes, etc.) and products available on www.apoteka-dar.rs.
privacy-policy.p78: With your consent, we record your behavior as a user on our website www.apoteka-dar.rs and newsletter. User behavior evaluation primarily involves data on the sections you visit and the links you use there. In this way, we create personalized user profiles with your personal data and/or with data about your email address in order to enable the creation of advertising offers from Apotekarska ustanova 'DAR' in the form of a newsletter, and printed material, tailored to your personal interests and thereby improve our offer.
privacy-policy.p79: The legal basis for processing data when sending newsletters is your consent in accordance with Article 12, paragraph 1, point 1) of the Law on Personal Data Protection.
privacy-policy.p80: In order to ensure that there are no errors when entering your email address, we use the so-called double-opt-in procedure. When you enter your email address in the registration field, we will send you a confirmation link. Only when you click on this confirmation, your email address will be entered into our mailing list.
privacy-policy.p81: You can revoke your consent to receive newsletters or create personalized user profiles at any time. Revoking your consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing that was carried out based on consent prior to revocation. You can do this by unsubscribing from the newsletter list on our website, for example. The unsubscribe link is at the end of each newsletter. If you revoke your consent, we will delete your data.
privacy-policy.p82: If we have engaged external partners to send newsletters, they are contractually obligated in accordance with Article 45 of the Law on Personal Data Protection. Any further disclosure of the data to third parties is excluded.
privacy-policy.p83: If you revoke your consent to our newsletter, we will delete your data from the corresponding mailing list for sending newsletters.
privacy-policy.p85: The following notes regarding data processing apply to you if you have contacted us, if you are negotiating with us to conclude a contract and/or if you already have a contract with us and personal data is processed in relation to this. Which data is processed in each individual case depends primarily on the services agreed upon. For this reason, not all parts of this section will be relevant to you.
privacy-policy.p86: How do we collect your data and what categories of data do we process?
privacy-policy.p87: We generally collect data directly from you. However, we may also collect data from other companies, government agencies or third parties, such as credit bureaus, tax authorities, etc. In addition, we may collect personal data through our systems for reporting possible violations of laws or internal guidelines. The following personal data may be processed: personal data (such as name and surname, address and other contact information, date and place of birth, as well as citizenship), identification and authentication data (such as extracts from the business register, data from identity cards, signature samples), data relating to our business relationship (such as payment data, order data), creditworthiness data, data on the company's structure and ownership structure, photographs and video recordings (e.g. during delivery of goods), as well as other data similar to the above-mentioned categories of data.
privacy-policy.p88: Purpose and legal basis of data processing.
privacy-policy.p89: Processing for the purpose of fulfilling contractual obligations (Article 12, Paragraph 1, Point 2) of the Law on Protection of Personal Data). Data is processed for the preparation of a contract conclusion that precedes the contractual relationship, as well as for the purpose of fulfilling obligations after the contract conclusion.
privacy-policy.p90: Processing for the purpose of fulfilling legal obligations (Article 12, Paragraph 1, Point 3) of the Law on Protection of Personal Data). The purpose of data processing arises, depending on the individual case, from legal regulations. For example, data is processed for the purpose of fulfilling obligations to keep documentation and in relation to identification, e.g. based on regulations for the prevention of money laundering, based on tax control and reporting, and processing data within queries of state authorities.
privacy-policy.p91: Processing for the purpose of fulfilling legitimate interests (Article 12, Paragraph 1, Point 6) of the Law on Protection of Personal Data). There may be a need to process personal data that you have provided in ways that go beyond the initial fulfillment of the contract. Our legitimate interests for such processing are selecting an appropriate business partner, fulfilling legal requirements, addressing liability claims, access control, clarifying possible breaches, preventing crimes, and processing damages that have arisen based on the contractual relationship.
privacy-policy.p92: In case of contract conclusion, for the purpose of fulfilling the aforementioned legitimate interests, we collect data on your creditworthiness through a credit bureau in individual cases. We process the creditworthiness data we received from the credit bureau for the purpose of checking your creditworthiness. The credit bureau keeps data that they receive from banks or companies, primarily including last name, first name, date of birth, addresses, and payment history information. You can obtain information about saved data related to you directly from the credit bureau.
privacy-policy.p93: Who has access to your data?
privacy-policy.p94: Within our healthcare institution, access to the data you provide is only available to those departments who require it to fulfill contractual or legal obligations or for the purpose of fulfilling legitimate interests. As part of our contractual relationship, we engage other service providers who may have access to your personal data. Compliance with personal data protection regulations is ensured in these cases by contract.
privacy-policy.p95: How long do we keep your data?
privacy-policy.p96: We keep personal data for as long as is necessary to fulfill the above mentioned purposes. We take into account the legal obligations for retention, for example the 5-year legal retention period in accordance with the Accounting Law.
privacy-policy.p97: Are you required to provide us with your data?
privacy-policy.p98: As part of our business relationship, you are obliged to provide us with personal data that is necessary to initiate, conduct and terminate the contractual relationship and to fulfill obligations associated with it, as well as for which we have a legal obligation or have the right based on legitimate interests. Without this information, we generally will not be able to initiate a business relationship with you.
privacy-policy.p99: What rights do you have as a data subject?
privacy-policy.p100: You have the right to request and receive information about your data that we process, free of charge. In addition, according to legal conditions, you have the right to rectify and delete your data, the right to data portability, and the right to restrict processing. If we process your personal data based on your consent, you have the right to withdraw that consent at any time. The revocation of consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing that was carried out before the withdrawal. Please contact us in writing or by email at the address of our data protection officer provided below in the event of any of these cases. In addition, if you do not agree with the processing of your personal data, you have the option to file a complaint with the state authority (Commissioner for Information of Public Importance and Personal Data Protection).
privacy-policy.p102: The responsible person for processing your data, or the data controller, is a pharmacy institution
privacy-policy.p103: based in Kragujevac, postal code 34000, at Kralja Aleksandra I Karadjordjevica Street 102, unit 9, registration number: 66597784, Tel.
privacy-policy.p105: DATA PROCESSING ON SOCIAL MEDIA PLATFORMS
privacy-policy.p106: For the processing of your data, the operator of a particular social media platform is also responsible. In addition, in some cases, we are also the operator of the platform, and in this sense, there is joint responsibility in accordance with Article 43 of the Law. The Pharmacy institution 'DAR' manages the following social media pages:
privacy-policy.p110: We have limited influence on the processing of data by the operator of social media platforms (e.g. administration of members and sharing of information). Where we can influence and adjust the parameters for the processing of your data so that the operator of social media platforms acts in accordance with data protection, we take all measures available to us. However, in many cases, we cannot influence the processing of data by the operator or know exactly which data the operator is processing.
privacy-policy.p111: The operator of the platform manages the entire IT infrastructure of the service, adheres to its own data protection rules, and has a special customer relationship with you (if you are a registered user of the social media service). Additionally, the operator is solely responsible for all matters relating to the data in your user profile, to which we as a company do not have access.
privacy-policy.p112: You can find more information about the processing of data by the operator of social media platforms and the possibilities for objection in their data protection rules:
privacy-policy.p116: On our social media pages, we process your data for the purpose of informing consumers about offers, products, services, promotions, sweepstakes, important information, news in the company, for the purpose of interacting with visitors to social media and for the purpose of answering questions, compliments, and criticisms.
privacy-policy.p117: We reserve the right to delete content if necessary. Additionally, we will share your data or content on our page if it serves the function of the social media platform. We process your data for the purpose of communicating with you.
privacy-policy.p118: Legal basis for processing your data.
privacy-policy.p119: Article 12, paragraph 1, point 6 of the Law (legitimate interest). The data processing is carried out in the interest of maintaining our public relations and communication. As we have already noted, wherever the social media platform operator provides us with the option, we take care to configure our pages in accordance with data protection.
privacy-policy.p120: The operator of the platform publishes the data that you have entered on our social media pages, such as comments, video recordings, pictures, likes, public notices, and so on, and we do not process them for any other purpose than the one intended. We reserve the right to delete illegal content if necessary. This is the case, for example, in the event of unlawful postings, hate comments, comments containing explicit sexual content, or attachments (such as pictures or video recordings) that, among other things, infringe on copyright or personal rights, constitute a criminal offense or violate the ethical principles of the pharmacy institution 'DAR.'
privacy-policy.p121: In this case, we may share your content on our page if it is a function of the social media platform. We process your data for the purpose of communicating with you. If you send us an inquiry via social media, we may direct you to other secure means of communication that guarantee confidentiality. Please note that you always have the option of sending us confidential inquiries via the email address provided in the general information or via the contact form.
privacy-policy.p122: In general, we do not disclose your data, which you send to us confidentially (such as private messages, correspondence, or email), to third parties. In exceptional cases, our external partners, to whom we entrust certain tasks in order to bring the services we provide to the highest level, may have access to your data. In that case, they are processors who use the data on our behalf. All of our partners are chosen very carefully and are contractually obligated to keep personal data confidential in accordance with Article 45 of the Law.
privacy-policy.p123: There may also be a need to forward part of your confidential inquiry to contractual partners (such as suppliers in the case of inquiries regarding specific products) for the purpose of processing your inquiry. However, in these cases, the inquiry is first anonymized so that the third party cannot associate them with you in any way. If it is necessary to forward your personal data in individual cases, we will inform you in advance and ask for your consent.
privacy-policy.p124: We delete or securely anonymize all personal data that you provide us with your inquiry (questions, suggestions, praise, or criticism) no later than 90 days after we give you a final response. We keep your data for 90 days because in individual cases, you as a consumer may contact us again regarding the response to the same question, and in that case, we must have the ability to build on previous correspondence. Our experience has shown that, as a rule, there are no further follow-up questions regarding our responses after 90 days.
privacy-policy.p125: All... (the rest of the text is cut off in the provided input).
privacy-policy.p128: You have the opportunity to participate in various prize games on our website, through our newsletter, on our social media, or on the website www.apoteka-dar.rs. Unless otherwise specified in a particular prize game or if you have not given us a different express consent, we will process the personal data that you have provided us with in the context of your participation in the prize game solely for the purpose of realizing the prize game (e.g. drawing/ determining the winner, notifying the winner, sending the prize, if necessary, anonymously publishing the winner). If you use your full name and surname on social media or if you are identifiable through photos on your profile, we cannot exclude your identification by other users.
privacy-policy.p129: The legal basis for processing your data within prize games is in principle Article 12 paragraph 1 point 2) (performance of a contract) of the Law. In case of giving consent within the prize game, the legal basis for data processing is consent in accordance with Article 12 paragraph 1 point 1) of the Law. In that case, you have the right to withdraw your consent at any time. Withdrawal of consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing based on consent before the withdrawal.
privacy-policy.p130: We only transmit data to third parties when necessary for the realization of the prize game, i.e. for sending the prize (e.g. sending the prize by the sponsor of the prize game or forwarding data to a logistics company) or if you have given us explicit consent. Please note that in some cases it is possible to participate in the prize game on pages with public access (e.g. on a notice board or via comments), so that other users can publicly see the fact of your participation through your interaction with us. In such cases, other users on social media may also become aware of your prize. If you use your full name and surname on social media or are recognizable through photos on your profile, we cannot exclude your identification by other users.
privacy-policy.p131: After the end of the prize game and the announcement of the winners, personal data of the participants are deleted, except for the data of the winners that we are legally obliged to keep when organizing the prize game. In case the prize is a product with a warranty, winner data is kept for the duration of the legal warranty period in order to, if necessary, arrange for repair or replacement in case of any defects. When participating in a prize game on social media (e.g. via posts or comments), we have no possibility to influence the deletion of your data by the operator. In that case, the operator's data protection rules apply.
privacy-policy.p133: You can subscribe to our newsletter through social media. If you have given consent to receive our newsletter, we will only process your email address data and, if necessary, your name, in order to send you (if possible, individual) information about products, promotions, contests, and news from our store offerings, as well as customer satisfaction surveys. We keep and process this data for the purpose of sending newsletters. The contents of the newsletter include product offerings, promotional discounts, contests, etc.
privacy-policy.p134: With your consent, we will record your behavior as a user of our website, which is collected at www.apoteka-dar.rs, as well as on our newsletter. The evaluation of user behavior primarily includes the categories in which you move on the relevant website or newsletter and which links you call up there. Personalized user profiles are created in the process, which are linked to your personality and/or email address, in order to direct marketing communication (primarily in the form of newsletters, advertising banners, and printed advertising) as much as possible towards your personal interests and to improve the advertising offer.
privacy-policy.p135: The legal basis for the above-mentioned processing of your data is your consent in accordance with Article 12(1)(1) of the Law.
privacy-policy.p136: In order to ensure that there is no error when entering your email address, we have set up the so-called Double-Opt-In procedure: after you enter your email address in the registration field, we will send you a confirmation link. Only when you click on that link will your email address be added to our mailing list.
privacy-policy.p137: Vašu saglasnost za prijem newslettera, učešće u anketama o zadovoljstvu kupaca i kreiranje personalizovanih korisničkih profila možete da opozovete u svako vreme. Link za odjavu možete pronaći u ovom tekstu ili na kraju svakog newsletter-a. Vašom odjavom smatramo da ste opozvali Vašu saglasnost za kreiranje Vašeg personalizovanog korisničkog profila i prijem newsletter-a. Vaše korisničke podatke tada brišemo. Opoziv ne utiče na dopuštenost obrade koja je vršena na osnovu pristanka pre opoziva.
privacy-policy.p138: If external partners - data processors are engaged to send newsletters, they are obligated by contract in accordance with Article 45 of the Law.
privacy-policy.p139: If you revoke your consent to receive our newsletter, your email address will be blocked from receiving the newsletter. Your data will be deleted from the relevant mailing lists six months later. When signing up on a social media platform, we have no way to influence the deletion of your data by the operator. In this case, the data protection rules of the specific operator apply.
privacy-policy.p140: Joint responsibility, Article 43 of the Law on the Protection of Personal Data
privacy-policy.p141: There is a relationship with the operator of the social network in accordance with Article 45 of the Law (joint responsibility):
privacy-policy.p142: For the web tracking methods that the operator of the social media platform enables, the operator and we share joint responsibility. Web tracking may occur regardless of whether you are logged in or registered on the social media platform. As we have already noted, we can unfortunately only limit our influence on the web tracking methods of the operator, for example, we cannot disable them.
privacy-policy.p143: The legal basis for web tracking methods is Article 12, Paragraph 1, Point 6) of the Law (legitimate interest). The legitimate and justified interest consists of optimizing the social media platform and the specific fan page (fan-page).
privacy-policy.p144: Other information about recipients, i.e., categories of recipients, as well as the storage period, i.e., criteria for determining the storage period, can be found in the data protection rules of the platform operator. We have no influence on these rules.
privacy-policy.p145: You can find information on how to prevent these web tracking methods in the data protection rules of the operator listed in point 2. In this regard, you can contact the platform operators using the contact information provided in their rules.
privacy-policy.p146: Regarding statistics that the operator of the social media platform provides us with, we can only conditionally influence and prevent them. However, we ensure that no additional optional statistics are provided to us.
privacy-policy.p147: From all the above, please be aware that it is not possible to exclude the possibility that the operator of the social media platform uses data from your profile as well as data about your behavior to, for example, assess your habits, personal relationships, tendencies, etc. The pharmacy institution 'DAR' has no influence on the processing or forwarding of your data by the operator of the social media platform.
privacy-policy.p149: In accordance with Article 26 of the Law, you have the right to request information or details about the processing of your data free of charge.
privacy-policy.p150: Additionally, provided that the legal conditions are met, you have the right to rectification (Article 29 of the Law), erasure (Article 30 of the Law) and the right to restrict processing (Article 31 of the Law).
privacy-policy.p151: If the processing of your data is based on Article 12, paragraph 1, points 5 or 6 of the Law, you have the right to object to the processing of data in accordance with Article 37 of the Law. If you object, we will be obliged to stop processing your data, unless we demonstrate that there are legal reasons for processing the data that outweigh the interests, rights or freedoms of the data subject.
privacy-policy.p152: If you have provided us with your data, in accordance with Article 36 of the Law, you have the right to transfer that data to another controller. As a rule, on social networks, you can only exercise this right directly to the social network operator, as only the operator has access to data from your profile.
privacy-policy.p153: If the processing of your data is based on your consent in accordance with Article 12, paragraph 1, point 1) of the Law, you have the right to withdraw your consent at any time. Withdrawal of consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal.
privacy-policy.p154: In order to exercise the aforementioned rights, as well as in case you have additional questions or complaints, please contact our Data Protection Officer using the contact information provided in the next section of this text.
privacy-policy.p155: In addition, in accordance with Article 82 of the Law, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the state body responsible for data protection (Commissioner for Information of Public Importance and Personal Data Protection).
privacy-policy.p156: If you wish to exercise your rights regarding the specific processing of your data, please contact us. We will then check your request (e.g. request for information or objection) or forward it to the relevant social media platform, if your request concerns the processing of data by the operator.
privacy-policy.p157: Contact person responsible for personal data protection at Pharmacy institution 'DAR':
privacy-policy.p158: If you have any additional questions or concerns regarding the processing of your data, please feel free to contact us, and we will do our best to assist you.
privacy-policy.p159: For this purpose, you can contact the person responsible for personal data protection at Pharmacy institution 'DAR' in writing or by e-mail: Pharmacy institution 'DAR', Kralja Aleksandra I Karađorđevića 102, lokal 9, 34000 Kragujevac, Personal Data Protection, E-Mail:
privacy-policy.p162: In addition to the right to withdraw your consent, if the legal conditions are met, you have the following rights:
privacy-policy.p163: the right to information about your personal data that we process, in accordance with Article 26 of the Law on Personal Data Protection,
privacy-policy.p164: the right to correction of inaccurate or incomplete data, in accordance with Article 29 of the Law on Personal Data Protection,
privacy-policy.p165: the right to erasure of your saved data, in accordance with Article 30 of the Law on Personal Data Protection,
privacy-policy.p166: the right to restriction of data processing, in accordance with Article 31 of the Law on Personal Data Protection,
privacy-policy.p167: the right to data portability, in accordance with Article 36 of the Law on Personal Data Protection,
privacy-policy.p168: the right to object, in accordance with Article 37 of the Law on Personal Data Protection.
privacy-policy.p169: 2. The right to information in accordance with Article 26 of the Law on Personal Data Protection
privacy-policy.p170: In accordance with Article 26 of the Law on Personal Data Protection, you have the right to request from us, free of charge, information on whether we process your personal data, access to that data, as well as information:
privacy-policy.p172: about the types of personal data being processed;
privacy-policy.p173: about the recipients or types of recipients to whom personal data have been or will be disclosed, particularly recipients in other countries or international organizations;
privacy-policy.p174: about the intended period of storage of personal data, or if this is not possible, about the criteria used to determine that period;
privacy-policy.p175: about the existence of the right to request correction or deletion of personal data, the right to restrict processing, and the right to object to processing; about the right to lodge a complaint with the state authority (Commissioner for Information of Public Importance and Personal Data Protection); about the source of personal data (available information) if the personal data are not collected from the data subject (you); about the existence of automated decision-making, including profiling under Article 38, paragraphs 1 and 4 of the Law on Personal Data Protection, and, at least in such cases, meaningful information about the logic used, as well as the significance and expected consequences of such processing for the data subject (you).
privacy-policy.p176: If personal data is transferred to another country or international organization, you have the right to be informed about the appropriate safeguards relating to the transfer, in accordance with Article 65 of the Law on Personal Data Protection.
privacy-policy.p177: 3. Right to correction in accordance with Article 29 of the Law on Personal Data Protection
privacy-policy.p178: You have the right to request that your inaccurate personal data be corrected without undue delay. Depending on the purpose of the processing, you have the right to complete your incomplete personal data, including by providing an additional statement.
privacy-policy.p179: 4. Right to erasure in accordance with Article 30 of the Law on Personal Data Protection
privacy-policy.p180: You have the right to request that your personal data be erased from our records in the following cases:
privacy-policy.p181: personal data are no longer necessary for the purposes for which they were collected or otherwise processed;
privacy-policy.p182: You have withdrawn consent on the basis of which the processing was carried out, in accordance with Article 12 paragraph 1 point 1) or Article 17 paragraph 2 point 1) of the Law on Personal Data Protection, and there is no other legal basis for processing;
privacy-policy.p183: When you object to processing in accordance with Article 37 paragraph 1 or 2 of the Law on Personal Data Protection, and there is no other legal basis for processing that overrides the legitimate interests, rights, or freedoms of the data subject;
privacy-policy.p184: Personal data have been processed unlawfully;
privacy-policy.p185: Personal data must be erased in order to comply with our legal obligations;
privacy-policy.p186: Personal data have been collected in connection with the use of information society services under Article 16 paragraph 1 of the Law on Personal Data Protection.
privacy-policy.p187: If we have publicly disclosed personal data and we are obliged to delete them, we will take all reasonable measures, including technical measures, in accordance with available technologies and the cost of their use, to inform other controllers who process that data, that you have requested the deletion of all copies of the data and the removal of electronic links to that data.
privacy-policy.p188: 5. Right to restriction of processing in accordance with Article 31 of the Law on Personal Data Protection
privacy-policy.p189: You have the right to request that we restrict the processing of your personal data if one of the following applies:
privacy-policy.p190: You contest the accuracy of the personal data, for a period enabling us to verify the accuracy of the personal data;
privacy-policy.p191: The processing is unlawful, and you oppose the erasure of the personal data and request the restriction of their use instead;
privacy-policy.p192: We (the controller) no longer need the personal data for the purposes of the processing, but you require them for the establishment, exercise, or defense of legal claims; or
privacy-policy.p193: You have objected to processing pursuant to Article 37 paragraph 1 of the Law on Personal Data Protection, and it is being assessed whether the controller's (our) legitimate grounds for processing override your interests.
privacy-policy.p194: 6. Right to data portability in accordance with Article 36 of the Law on Personal Data Protection.
privacy-policy.p195: You have the right to receive your personal data, which you have previously provided to us, in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format and you have the right to transmit those data to another controller without hindrance from us if the following conditions are met:
privacy-policy.p196: processing is based on consent pursuant to Article 12 paragraph 1 point 1) or Article 17 paragraph 2 point 1) of the Personal Data Protection Act or on a contract pursuant to Article 12 paragraph 1 point 2) of the same Act; processing is carried out automatically.
privacy-policy.p197: This right also includes the right to have your personal data transmitted directly from us to another controller, where technically feasible.
privacy-policy.p198: 7. Right to object pursuant to Article 37 of the Personal Data Protection Act
privacy-policy.p199: Under the conditions set out in Article 37 paragraph 1 of the Personal Data Protection Act, data processing may be subject to objection for reasons relating to your particular situation.
privacy-policy.p200: This general right of objection applies to all processing purposes described in these data protection rules that are processed on the basis of Article 12 paragraph 1 point 6) of the Personal Data Protection Act. Unlike the right to object to data processing for commercial purposes (see point 6), we are obliged under the Personal Data Protection Act to apply such a general right of objection only if there are compelling reasons for doing so, such as potential danger to life or health. In addition, you have the option of contacting the state authority responsible for personal data protection or the person responsible for data protection at Apotekarska ustanova 'DAR'
privacy-policy.p201: These personal data protection rules apply to the website www.apoteka-dar.rs and to data processing by us as data controller: Apotekarska ustanova DAR, in Kragujevac, postal code 34000, at Kralja Aleksandra I Karađorđevića Street No.102, premises No.9.
